candidate_state: release candidate from the verified release-preparation commit

internal_measurement.results: Workspace release tests, Clippy with warnings denied, rustfmt, the optional opening-book feature, NNUE export precision and integer-checkpoint compatibility tests, documentation and public-contract checks, a native material-only USI smoke, WebAssembly release compilation, package generation, and generated JavaScript contract checks passed. The nearest-integer FT export reduced the focused test RMSE from about 0.0088 to about 0.0044 without changing existing checkpoint loading. Browser execution remains a GitHub CI publication gate.

external_opponents.configuration: No external engine, evaluator, weights, labels, Suisho5-derived scores, or Suisho5-derived opening positions are used as release evidence for v0.3.62.

known_limitations: The NNUE change affects newly exported FT parameters and their file checksums; existing NNUE files and checkpoint loading behavior are unchanged.
No new NNUE checkpoint is bundled or adopted, and this release makes no playing-strength claim.
The optional v0.3.38 checkpoint and its material-baseline recommendation remain unchanged.
Parallel search can vary by scheduler; deterministic diagnostics require one thread and SpecTopN=0.
The WebAssembly package is distributed as a GitHub Release asset and is not published to the npm registry.
External HalfKP inference remains optional and requires a separately obtained, license-compatible nn.bin file with its own provenance and operating scale.
